identification: Three old irons: a Chinese brass charcoal 'pan' (silk) iron with wooden handle, a chrome/nickel electric iron with blue handle (likely 1920s-30s), and a cast-iron sad iron

entries.note: Vintage Chinese brass silk (coal) iron, wood handle with coins, 16in long, 6 bids; this is only the Chinese pan iron part of the Armitage lot, and an old US result. [AUD 26 converted at USD 1 = AUD 1.54]
